description: Write a pandas ETL script for media_stream that groups page-view events into sessions and aggregates them. A new session starts for a user when the gap from that user's previous event is strictly greater than 30 minutes. The script should: (1) parse event_ts to UTC and sort by user_id and event_ts, (2) assign a per-user session number, (3) aggregate per session: session_start, session_end, event_count and duration_seconds, (4) assign session_date from session_start so that sessions crossing midnight are not split, (5) build session_id as '<user_id>-<n>'.
edge_cases: A gap of exactly 30 minutes (10:10 to 10:40) stays in the same session; 31 minutes (10:40 to 11:11) starts a new one
The gap must be computed within each user: diff() over the whole sorted frame compares u2's first event with u1's last event
u2's session crosses midnight and must remain one session dated 2025-10-01
A single-event session has a duration of 0 seconds
common_failure_modes: FM3: Gap computed across user boundaries merges or splits sessions incorrectly
FM2: Grouping by calendar date before sessionizing splits sessions at midnight
FM2: Off-by-one on the 30-minute threshold (>= instead of >)
